title: Nested rollouts timeline: compact-mode gesture & edgecase specs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Objective: Design a compact, nested timeline for rollout variants that scales to dense project lists and supports gesture interactions on touch and trackpad. Deliverables: high-fidelity compact-mode screens, interactive Figma prototype (peek-and-expand gesture), animation spec, accessibility fallback behaviors, QA checklist, and dev handoff tokens/components.
acceptance_criteria: Compact timeline renders correctly with up to 4 nested variants per rollout without horizontal overflow
Peek-and-expand gesture reveals variant details in-place (no route change) with <150ms perceived latency
Reduced-motion and keyboard-only flows provide parity: all actions reachable via keyboard and announce important state changes via aria-live
Token-level cost microbadges render consistently at 12px and are readable at 90% contrast
Handoff includes a tabular spec (spacing, timing, component props) and a single PR linking to Figma + prototype
constraints: Must reuse existing timeline component primitives where possible (slot-based indicator, density props)
Animations must be optional via a global reduced-motion flag
Compact mode cannot increase API surface; prefer config flags over new endpoints
decisions_and_tradeoffs: Chose a layered stacking approach for nested variants to minimize height growth; tradeoff is slightly higher z-order complexity for hover/gesture hit testing
Opted to collapse variant labels into microchips in ultra-dense states to preserve alignment; tradeoff is reduced immediate label readability in extreme densities
Prioritized keyboard parity over multi-pointer gestures: all gestures have keyboard equivalents to satisfy accessibility goals
implementation_notes: Dev should expose 'density' and 'compactMode' props and a 'peek' boolean that toggles inline expansion
Use requestAnimationFrame batching for peek animations and keep main thread synchronous updates minimal
Provide a11y-only helper text for screen readers describing nested counts when collapsed (e.g., '3 variants collapsed')
Add telemetry events: rollout.peek_open, rollout.peek_close, rollout.variant_select for event-driven analytics
qa_checklist: Verify keyboard navigation: Tab/Enter opens peek, Escape closes, Arrow keys navigate variants
Validate reduced-motion flag disables non-essential transitions and still shows state changes
Test at 75%, 90%, and 125% text scale for truncation and microbadge legibility
Confirm aria-live announcements when a variant state changes (canary -> healthy -> failed)
Cross-browser test: Chrome, Safari, Firefox on macOS and Windows; mobile: iOS Safari, Chrome on Android
